RecurringPaymentService/Charge.recurring_charge: wallet MIT (TRANSARMOR token from a wallet CIT Authorize) cannot be exercised via this suite: RecurringPaymentService/Charge depends on PaymentService/SetupRecurring for the mandate ID, but fiservcommercehub SetupMandate only supports Card — wallet mandate tokens are issued inline during PaymentService/Authorize with setup_future_usage=OFF_SESSION and are tested there via no3ds_auto_capture_apple_pay_decrypted_cit and no3ds_auto_capture_google_pay_decrypted_cit.
